Q: PHP shorttags not echoing values in foreach block of a CodeIgniter view file A:

It looks like you don't have short tags turned on in your apache install.

Short tags allow you to do <?= ?> rather than <?php echo($title); ?>

Q: How to compile C program in Visual Studio Code? A:

It sounds like you're not working on a workspace or you don't have a C compiler installed, I recommend you follow these steps

1. Work inside a folder

  • Create a new folder on your Desktop (e.g, /helloworld)

  • Move hello.c into it

  • Open VS Code and use File > Open Folder to open that specific directory

2. Install a C Compiler

  • Windows: Install MinGW-w64 (GCC) (look up a tutorial if you need to)

  • macOS: Open the terminal and run xcode-select --install to get Apple Clang

  • Linux: you would probably already know

3. Once the compiler is installed and your system path is updated, restart VS Code

  • Open hello.c

  • Click the Play button in the top right corner of the editor

  • Select Run C/C++ File

  • Choose your newly installed compiler (GCC or Clang) from the prompt. It will compile the code and print "Hello world!" in the terminal at the bottom
